name: gqrac3-area-claim-warnings
goal: The area-claim launch gate holds a launch only when two sessions declared the same code area; a missing GitHub read binding, unknown or inferred areas, over 512 mentioned paths, open pull requests, undeclared runs and an unreachable hub become warnings in the session brief

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: r1304 reproduction at c6fc9eb4e7: with the live launcher routing (no github binding: 0/6 primary, 0/4 MB2) #462 holds every GitHub-checkout launch; items naming no path claim '.' and block each other; >512 mentioned paths throws and holds; open PRs hold. Expected (Daniel via CoS 17:05Z, Option 1): hold only when two sessions declared the same code area (Areas: lines or tracker claim); otherwise start and warn in the brief.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: #462's tests asserted the strict behaviour (inventory rejects without a GitHub binding; unknown text claims every open PR) and its dispatch test only used declared areas on a non-Git root with a hub link, so no fixture routed a GitHub checkout without a binding or two items with no declared areas; 4 older tracker-host-resources/quota-pause tests do the latter and were not run before. New reusable fixture test/support/trackerAreaFixture.ts routes a GitHub origin with no binding by default.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red at 6ba9ecec4f (rebased on main 2ce7a068e4): 6 files, assertion 'expected [] to deeply equal [ nobind0001 ]' reproduced on unchanged product code.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 015c76b7b7: hold only on a declared same-area clash; every other case warns in the session brief. No test file changed in the repair.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green at 015c76b7b7: the same 6 unchanged test files, fixtures and command pass.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
